Healthcare · Design & build

Prime Medical Centre & Pharmacy

Reef Mall, Dubai

Project value
AED 1.7 million
Duration
4 months
Completed
2017

Project overview

The single-storey centre included consultation and examination rooms, testing areas, a lead-lined X-ray room, nurse stations, waiting areas, and reception.

The design and build scope required fitting the clinical programme within budget while selecting materials and finishes permitted by the mall authority and Dubai Health Authority.

Project team: Apple Fit Out Interiors
